question: On 21 November 2022, who assumed charge as the new Election Commissioner (EC) of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arun Goel.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arun Goel **assumed charge as the **new Election Commissioner (EC)** of India on **21 November 2022.**
 
• He succeeded **Sushil Chandra **who retired from the post on** 20 November 2022.**
 
• Arun Goel is a** 1984-batch Indian Administrative Service** (IAS) officer of** Punjab cadre.**
 
• He has served in various positions in the state and central governments, including as **Secretary in the Ministry of Culture**.
 
• Arun Goel's appointment as the new EC was made by the** President of India** on the recommendation of the Prime Minister-led selection committee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Current as of April 2024**: Chief Election Commissioner Shri Rajiv Kumar

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

Additional Information__**

 
• **Manoj Kumar **is a common name and there is no information available about an** IAS officer** with this name being appointed as the new EC.
 
• **Rajiv Kumar** is a former **Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog **and has not been appointed as the new EC.
 
• **Anup Chandra Pandey **is a **retired IAS officer **who served as the **ChiefSecretary of Uttar Pradesh** and is currently the Election Commissioner of India.
